changelog:
Initial release of scrapfly-sdk-typescript.

- Web scraping SDK for TypeScript/JavaScript supporting Node.js, Deno, Bun, and edge runtimes.
- Features include proxy rotation, anti-bot bypass (ASP), JavaScript rendering, screenshots, and AI-powered extraction.
- Supports concurrent scraping, geo-targeting, and multiple output formats (raw, HTML, JSON, markdown, text).
- Simple setup with API key and npm/JSR installation.
- Provides concise examples for scraping, rendering, screenshots, and data extraction.
summary: Web scraping from TypeScript or JavaScript with the Scrapfly SDK (`scrapfly-sdk`). Use when the user asks to scrape a URL, bypass anti-bot protection, render...
